theme_archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast with Neo-Tactical B2B Edge

core_principles: Data Density over Decorative Padding: Use the 'Control Room' grid protocol. Maximize screen real estate for ledgers and tables.
Utilitarian Aesthetics: No glowing gradients, no purple AI magic. The design must feel like a precision instrument—sharp, exact, and fast.
Optical Alignment & Hierarchy: Use radical weight contrast in typography rather than relying purely on color for hierarchy.
design_philosophy.ai_treatment: AI insights are presented as calculated, terminal-style outputs (Monochrome Silver + Warm Amber), not mystical generative features. No sparkles, no purple/teal gradients.

typography.installation_instructions: Load Cabinet Grotesk via Fontshare, IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts.

spacing_and_radius.spacing_strategy: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between widgets. Card internal padding p-5 or p-6. Zero empty vertical spaces; columns must align uniformly.

layout_patterns.app_shell: Left vertical fixed sidebar (w-64) with dark obsidian theme in both light/dark modes to ground the application. Top bar (h-14) with global command palette search, notifications, and user dropdown. Main content area uses a fluid grid with max-w-screen-2xl container.
layout_patterns.kpi_cards: Flat design. 1px solid border (border-border). No default shadow. On hover: shadow-sm and -translate-y-[1px]. Upper-left title, large primary metric in the center, and a bottom-aligned compact trend indicator (e.g., '+12% vs last month').
layout_patterns.customer_360_split: 2-column layout. Left column (col-span-1 md:col-span-4): Sticky Customer Profile + AI Insight Panel. Right column (col-span-1 md:col-span-8): Tabs for Ledger, Invoices, Payments, Scheme Eligibility.
layout_patterns.ai_insight_panel: The 'Monochrome Terminal' look. Pale amber/silver background. 1px solid border matching the text color at 20% opacity. Use mono typography for confidence scores and risk ratings. Add a subtle SVG noise pattern overlay. NO PURPLE GRADIENTS.
layout_patterns.data_tables: High density. Row height max 40px (h-10). Columns with monetary values or percentages MUST be right-aligned and use JetBrains Mono tabular-nums. Zebra striping disabled; rely on row hover backgrounds (hover:bg-muted/50).

motion.philosophy: Utilitarian. Used exclusively to reinforce state changes.
motion.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) for cards, subtle background color shift for rows/buttons.
motion.page_transition: Fade in with a minor upward slide: animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-300

icons.strategy: Use sparingly. Primarily in the sidebar, command palette, and empty states. Avoid using icons beside every table header.

login_hero_bg.description: Abstract architectural interior of a high-tech logistics and electronics distribution center, glowing warm amber lights, obsidian black walls, stacked geometric forms.

empty_state_illustration.strategy: Avoid generic vector illustrations. Use typographic art or highly structural ASCII/monoline SVGs using the border/muted text color. Keep it strictly professional.

testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case denoting their role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='customer-table-row').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all fonts are imported properly in index.html or layout file.
Configure tailwind.config.js to map these color tokens exactly, especially custom AI colors.
Do NOT use Shadcn's default Card styling if it includes heavy box-shadows. Override it to be flat with a 1px border.
Implement the Layout with a fixed sidebar. The sidebar should always have a dark theme (bg-zinc-950) even in light mode to act as an anchor.
Utilize the login_hero_bg URL for the login screen's split layout (left side form, right side image with black/40 overlay).
Apply 'tabular-nums' utility to all numeric table cells and charts.
Ensure the AI insight panels have the SVG noise background and use the specific monochrome terminal colors provided. NEVER use gradients.
